LightningComponentBundle.description: A specialized lookup input field component for use in Flow screens. Provides a streamlined interface for selecting records with built-in validation and Flow integration.

property.name: value
property.label: Selected Record ID
property.description: The ID of the selected record. This value is updated when a user selects a record.

property.name: sobjectType
property.label: Object API Name
property.description: The API name of the object to search (e.g., Account, Contact, CustomObject__c)

property.name: label
property.label: Field Label
property.description: The label displayed above the lookup field

property.name: fieldName
property.label: Field API Name
property.description: The API name of the field. Used in change events for identifying which field was modified. If not provided, defaults to 'value'.

property.name: helpText
property.label: Help Text
property.description: Helpful text that appears when users hover over the help icon

property.name: required
property.label: Required
property.description: Makes the field required. Users must select a record before proceeding.

property.name: disabled
property.label: Disabled
property.description: Disables the lookup field, preventing user interaction

property.name: readOnly
property.label: Read Only
property.description: Makes the field read-only. Similar to disabled but with different styling.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID
property.description: Optional: The ID of the record that provides context for the form. Used when the lookup should be aware of the parent record context.
